item.title: I-65 North reopens in north Jefferson County following crash
item.description: A crash involving a commercial vehicle caused the northbound lanes of I-65 in north Jefferson County to close Saturday morning, according to the Alabama Law Enforcement Agency.

item.title: Man leaves Tuscaloosa house following domestic violence call
item.description: A man left a house following a domestic violence call Saturday morning, according to the Tuscaloosa Police Department.

item.title: 3 Doors Down's Brad Arnold dies after cancer fight
item.description: Brad Arnold, the frontman for the rock band 3 Doors Down, has died after a battle with kidney cancer. Arnold passed away on February 7, 2026, at the age of 47.

item.title: Trump praises Nexstar-Tegna broadcast television deal he once opposed
item.description: President Donald Trump on Saturday endorsed Nexstar Media Group's $6.2 billion purchase of broadcast rival Tegna, an apparent reversal from earlier criticism of the deal.
